name: Son-uva Digger

specialAbility.name: Legacy Power
specialAbility.description: Son-uva Digger channels the legendary power of its father, supercharging its smash damage to terrifying levels!

lore: The son of the most famous monster truck ever built, Son-uva Digger has something to prove! With even brighter green flames and a meaner growl than its legendary parent, this truck fights twice as hard to make its own name. It carries the Digger family crest with pride and smashes with PURPOSE!
